_about: TRV, 2026-09-29: the Secular Compounder's watched plan (minted 23:02 ET 09-28 by writer run cmum387fw000b04jpyc607ao6) and the 09:30:27 ET set-down that removed it (ThesisUpdate cmumprvlh000604jvt06eurv2). thesisBefore is the row as the five-minute check found it: the four triggers still stored, plus the buy, floor and target the set-down removed, rebuilt from the writer's final decision under the ids the set-down recorded. Built read-only by a script.

triggers.rationale: 50-day SMA reclaim at $372.51 confirms buyers have returned to the base and the pullback has held — COMPOUNDER_ACCUMULATION entry trigger.

Under the last swing low at $359.87 (printed September 9, 2026) — 1.9 ATR below entry of $372.51 ($372.51 - $359.87 = $12.64, approximately 1.9× ATR of $6.70); the stop sits at a natural price structure floor and invalidates the 50-day reclaim if breached.

Measured move: 14.3% base depth applied to the $372.51 entry pivot = $425.78, consistent with the 1.272 Fibonacci extension at $431.53 and aligning with the Roth Capital bull price target of $425; R multiple: ($425 - $372.51) / ($372.51 - $359.87) = $52.49 / $12.64 = 4.2R.
Q3 2026 earnings in ~7 days — review position sizing, combined ratio expectations, and NII guidance before the report.
A 10%+ EPS beat confirms the underwriting and NII compounding thesis is intact — review whether to size up after confirmation.
Any earnings miss warrants reviewing whether the underlying combined ratio or NII trajectory has deteriorated, as these are the two core assumptions.
60-day business checkpoint: has the underlying combined ratio trajectory and NII growth started proving out? If not, name what is missing or exit.

Gave back 15% from the high. This is a question, not a sale: is the reason we bought still true? If yes, hold and raise the floor under real structure (the 20-day low, the breakout level). If partly, trim. Sell only if you can name what broke in the business.
Gave back 25% from the high — the catastrophe line for a multi-year hold. The review at 15% should have acted long before this; if we are here, protect the capital.
Below the 200-day — the long trend is in question. Review the business, not the chart.
Up 15% from entry — re-underwrite at the new price and raise the floor under real structure (DAV-279 ruling).
Down 15% from entry — decide hold-vs-cut deliberately, before the stop decides (DAV-279 ruling).
Down 7% in a day — evaluate a pullback-add ONLY if the drop is market/sector-wide with the thesis intact. A company-specific drop is thesis damage: do not add — hold, trim, or exit. Approval-gated.
Up 7% in a day — strength on a held name. Evaluate pressing the winner (add + raise target/stop) if the move is thesis-confirming, not an exhaustion spike. Approval-gated.
Look at this every 7 days, counting from the last real review.
Reports within 3 days — decide before the print: hold through it, trim, or wait to add. Size for the gap.
Reported a beat — re-underwrite. A clean beat-and-raise earns a higher target; a beat the stock sold on means the market wanted more.
Reported a miss — is the thesis wrong, or early? Decide deliberately before the stop decides for us.

Filed something material with the SEC — read the filing first; the code says what happened, not whether it's good. A restatement or bankruptcy breaks the numbers; an officer leaving or a deal can change the story.

setDown.summary: TRV plan set down — the floor broke before we ever bought it, so the plan's premise is gone.
